summary.short: Ministerial normative ordinance setting guidelines for Access Seasons under Decree 12.772/2025 (PNAST): ONS registration of agents, capacity calculation, competitive processes with premium bids where requests exceed capacity, and premium use for tariff modicity. Binding on grid agents and the ONS from publication.
summary.long: Portaria Normativa MME nº 129/2026 sets guidelines for the Access Seasons (Temporadas de Acesso) created by Decree 12.772/2025 (PNAST), for permanent access to the national basic transmission grid or increases in contracted use. The ONS runs a registration (Cadastramento) of interested agents and checks admissibility within fifteen days. The ONS calculates remaining capacity at connection points from PAR/PEL reference cases; the methodology note is joint ONS and EPE, and the quantities note is published at least thirty days before each competitive process. Where requested use exceeds capacity, a competitive process ranks bids by the highest premium in R$/kW, paid upfront. Winners and eligible agents receive a Prior Access Diagnosis enabling a CUST, conditioned on a financial guarantee. Non-compliance may lead to loss of allocated capacity, execution of the participation guarantee and exclusion from the two subsequent seasons. Premiums are allocated to reducing transmission charges (EUST). Transitional rules cover generation winners of energy auctions that use grid margin as a selection criterion. The instrument revokes MME Portarias 311/2013 and 24/2014 and takes effect on publication.
